# Copilot Instructions for ONNX Runtime

Read and follow [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) for repository-wide guidance, including codebase conventions, architecture,
and coding standards.

Only for changes with a direct or traceable effect on native WebGPU, use
[code-review-webgpu](skills/code-review-webgpu/SKILL.md) with [code-review](skills/code-review/SKILL.md).
Follow its scope gate and open applicable references. Unrelated reviews do not use WebGPU skills or checks.
